name: web-dev-plugin
description: Marketplace for the web-dev plugins: web-dev (folder web-dev/) and web-quality (folder web-quality/).

plugins.name: web-dev
plugins.description: Web development for a React + Effect + TanStack Query stack: one entry point (/web-dev:develop) for new and existing projects, with project setup, feature development, API integration, UI development and deploy setup, the ticket, incident and pr skills that write the contracts around the code, and release, which takes a merged pull request to production. Its guardrails hook runs before each of Claude's tool calls in every folder while the plugin is enabled and refuses history rewrites, force-pushes, skipped git hooks, pushes to a protected branch, merging a pull request, production deploys and reading secret files.

plugins.name: web-quality
plugins.description: Measurement-first web quality for single-page apps on React + Vite: /web-quality:audit measures a page in a real browser and its build (Core Web Vitals, bundle budgets, response headers, accessibility, SEO), separates measured findings from hypotheses, and routes fixes to the performance, accessibility, seo and security skills.
